title: Run a typed decision-plane Agentic Recipe with batched questions
narrative: Fangore projects only the state a decision needs, asks several bounded questions in one model step, keeps exact facts in code, and lets product policy choose the final action — escalating when confidence is too low. Builds on `fangore_decision_surface_reject` for allowed-action envelopes.
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` (`DecisionPlaneTemplate`) builds project_state → ask_batch → apply_policy with an escalate exit. Inputs carry a structured state projection, deterministic facts, and a batch of typed questions with valid-action envelopes. Soft points bind runner kinds, confidence floor, and escalation route; shadow_mode adds a non-gating shadow ask node (DP-01..07).
validation: Kind `decision_plane_recipe`. Soft expects batched question count on ask_batch, escalate node present, facts outside ask payload, and template_name `decision_plane`. Static expansion only (no model call).
